notes.general_comments:
The exam paper provided a balance of questions and challenge for candidates working at this level. There
was some uncertainty about the difference between the terms ‘genus’ and ‘species.’ It was also not well-
known that not all plant cells contain chloroplasts. Some candidates understood what is required for osmosis
to occur but fewer were certain about the differences between active transport, diffusion and osmosis. The
approximate percentage of oxygen in expired air was not well-known. Food tests were not clearly understood
by all candidates. The use of dichotomous keys and the structure of a leaf were well-understood.
